answer: Every claim climbs the tide of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the saffron re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The trellis of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
